# Anuj Sadani

> Principal Engineer at Infrrd, based in Pune, India. Builds enterprise GenAI systems — RAG platforms, agent tooling on MCP, fine-tuned small models, model routing and evaluation — and leads the teams that build them. Owns the organisation-wide Python stack. Writes about AI engineering, infrastructure, and security.

Working principle: people, then business, then technology. Not a ranking of what is interesting, but an order of operations — when it inverts, something downstream breaks.

## Current role

- [Infrrd](https://www.infrrd.ai/): Principal Engineer, Jan 2021–present (Principal Software Development Engineer since May 2025; ML Engineering Technical Architect 2021–2025). Owns the GenAI and ML architecture behind a document extraction platform that peaks around 1M pages a day, held to 1–4¢ per page depending on document class. Designed the hybrid ML+LLM routing that keeps it there: 30–40% cheaper than an LLM-only design. Built the MCP-based agent tooling layer for mortgage document processing. Fine-tunes small open models for entity extraction in the production path. Owns the enterprise-wide Python stack. Leads 12+ Python/ML engineers across three teams.

## Background

- Delivery Hero, Berlin: Software Engineer II, Feb–Dec 2020. Python/Flask microservices for a high-traffic logistics platform.
- Nvidia, Pune: Aug 2009–Jan 2020, ending as Senior Tools Development Engineer. Led 8+ engineers on embedded automation frameworks and internal engineering tooling.
- B.E. Information Technology, Government College of Engineering, Amravati.

## Technical scope

- Generative AI: RAG, agentic systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool design and gating, model evaluation, LLMs, SLMs, vision-language models, embeddings, vector databases
- Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, PydanticAI, DSPy
- Serving and routing: AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Vertex AI, vLLM, Ollama, LiteLLM, OpenRouter, multi-provider routing and fallback
- Training and data: fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA), quantization, synthetic data generation, YOLO, OCR, spaCy, Databricks
- Platform: Python, FastAPI, Flask, microservices, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
